subTagline: An old-school Chicago deli and bakery counter, set up in the Louis Joliet Mall food court.
footerTagline: Wholistic, good food. Louis Joliet Mall.

do: Talk like the counter, not the boardroom.
Specific over general. ('Pink-frosted butter cookies' beats 'baked goods.')
dont: No site-wide claims we can't make item-by-item.
No exclamation marks unless something deserves one.

ctaCopy.twoWaysIn: Two ways in. Order ahead for pickup, or come find us at the counter.

noPorkExplainer: A small stamp marks items on our all-beef line — Vienna Beef hot dogs and Polish, our corned beef and pastrami. Item by item, not a slogan.
DessertExplainer: From the bakery case to the box. Classic Chicago butter cookies, rich cheesecakes, and fresh-baked sweets to finish the job.
SideExplainer: The necessary hardware for a proper meal. Golden fries, house-made slaw, and a crisp dill pickle spear on the side.
PlateExplainer: Heavy-hitting dinners when a sandwich won't cut it. Sizzling jerk chicken and street tacos that demand a fork and a sit-down.
DeliExplainer: The foundation of the house. Slow-cured corned beef and hot pastrami, stacked high on fresh marble rye. No shortcuts.
DogsExplainer: Authentic Vienna Beef, dragged through the garden. Classic Chicago dogs and grilled Maxwell Street Polish loaded with sweet onions.
DrinksExplainer: Ice-cold sodas and refreshing pours to wash it all down. The perfect pairing for a heavy plate or a stacked sandwich.
